name: Build NetShare APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build APK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    env:
      BUILD_DIR: /home/runner/NetShareBuild

    steps:

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      # ── Cache Gradle (FIXED #1: moved before build so first run benefits from cache) ──
      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          # FIXED #8: hashFiles path now covers the build dir outside workspace via a
          # stable fallback key. Since hashFiles() only scans GITHUB_WORKSPACE we use
          # a fixed secondary key so the cache is still saved/restored across runs.
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-netshare-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-netshare-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-

      # ── Initialize React Native scaffold ─────────────────────
      - name: Initialize React Native project
        run: |
          cd /home/runner
          npx --yes react-native@0.73.4 init NetShareBuild --version 0.73.4 --skip-install
        env:
          CI: false

      # ── Copy JS source files ──────────────────────────────────
      # FIXED #9: package.json is now MERGED instead of blindly overwritten,
      # so RN scaffold deps are preserved alongside your custom deps.
      - name: Copy JS source files
        run: |
          # Core files (everything except package.json — merged separately below)
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/App.jsx"                    "$BUILD_DIR/App.jsx"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/index.js"                   "$BUILD_DIR/index.js"

          # Source folders
          mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/src/screens" "$BUILD_DIR/src/services" "$BUILD_DIR/src/store"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src/screens/HomeScreen.jsx" "$BUILD_DIR/src/screens/"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src/services/VpnService.js" "$BUILD_DIR/src/services/"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src/store/index.js"         "$BUILD_DIR/src/store/"

          echo "=== JS files copied ==="
          ls "$BUILD_DIR/"

      - name: Merge package.json
        run: |
          python3 -c "
import json, os
wp = os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE']
bd = os.environ['BUILD_DIR']
repo = json.load(open(wp+'/package.json'))
scaf = json.load(open(bd+'/package.json'))
merged = scaf.copy()
for k in ('dependencies','devDependencies'):
    if k in repo: merged.setdefault(k,{}).update(repo[k])
for k in ('name','version','scripts'):
    if k in repo: merged[k]=repo[k]
json.dump(merged,open(bd+'/package.json','w'),indent=2)
print('package.json merged OK')
"

      # ── Write AndroidManifest ─────────────────────────────────
      - name: Write AndroidManifest
        run: |
          python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import os
manifest = """<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"utf-8\"?>
<manifest xmlns:android=\"http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android\">

    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.INTERNET\" />
    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE\" />
    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE\" />
    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED\" />
    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE\" />
    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE\" />
    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE\" />
    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE\" />
    <!-- FIXED #12: BIND_VPN_SERVICE must be declared as a uses-permission for the app to start VPN -->
    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.BIND_VPN_SERVICE\" />

    <application
        android:name=\".MainApplication\"
        android:label=\"@string/app_name\"
        android:icon=\"@mipmap/ic_launcher\"
        android:roundIcon=\"@mipmap/ic_launcher_round\"
        android:allowBackup=\"false\"
        android:theme=\"@style/AppTheme\"
        android:usesCleartextTraffic=\"true\">

        <activity
            android:name=\".MainActivity\"
            android:label=\"@string/app_name\"
            android:configChanges=\"keyboard|keyboardHidden|orientation|screenLayout|screenSize|smallestScreenSize|uiMode\"
            android:launchMode=\"singleTask\"
            android:windowSoftInputMode=\"adjustResize\"
            android:exported=\"true\">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name=\"android.intent.action.MAIN\" />
                <category android:name=\"android.intent.category.LAUNCHER\" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <service
            android:name=\"com.netsharebuild.netshare.NetShareVpnService\"
            android:permission=\"android.permission.BIND_VPN_SERVICE\"
            android:exported=\"false\"
            android:foregroundServiceType=\"connectedDevice\">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name=\"android.net.VpnService\" />
            </intent-filter>
        </service>

    </application>
</manifest>"""
dest = os.path.join(os.environ["BUILD_DIR"], "android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml")
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest), exist_ok=True)
with open(dest, "w") as f:
    f.write(manifest)
print("Manifest OK")
PYEOF

      # ── Write Java native files ───────────────────────────────
      - name: Write Java native files
        run: |
          DEST="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/java/com/netsharebuild/netshare"
          mkdir -p "$DEST"

          python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import os

dest = os.environ["BUILD_DIR"] + "/android/app/src/main/java/com/netsharebuild/netshare"
os.makedirs(dest, exist_ok=True)

# ── VpnPackage.java ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
vpn_package = """\
package com.netsharebuild.netshare;
import com.facebook.react.ReactPackage;
import com.facebook.react.bridge.NativeModule;
import com.facebook.react.bridge.ReactApplicationContext;
import com.facebook.react.uimanager.ViewManager;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
public class VpnPackage implements ReactPackage {
    @Override
    public List<NativeModule> createNativeModules(ReactApplicationContext reactContext) {
        List<NativeModule> modules = new ArrayList<>();
        modules.add(new VpnModule(reactContext));
        return modules;
    }
    @Override
    public List<ViewManager> createViewManagers(ReactApplicationContext reactContext) {
        return Collections.emptyList();
    }
}
"""

# ── VpnModule.java ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# FIXED #6: removed static ReactApplicationContext field (memory leak).
#           emitEvent() now uses getReactApplicationContext() safely.
# FIXED #5: stopVpn() now uses stopService() instead of startService()
#           to avoid IllegalStateException on Android 8+ when app is backgrounded.
vpn_module = """\
package com.netsharebuild.netshare;
import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.VpnService;
import android.os.Build;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import com.facebook.react.bridge.ActivityEventListener;
import com.facebook.react.bridge.Promise;
import com.facebook.react.bridge.ReactApplicationContext;
import com.facebook.react.bridge.ReactContextBaseJavaModule;
import com.facebook.react.bridge.ReactMethod;
import com.facebook.react.modules.core.DeviceEventManagerModule;
public class VpnModule extends ReactContextBaseJavaModule implements ActivityEventListener {
    private static final int VPN_REQUEST_CODE = 0x0F;
    private Promise vpnPermissionPromise;
    // FIXED #6: no longer storing ReactApplicationContext as a static field.
    // Use a WeakReference or getReactApplicationContext() from the base class instead.
    private static VpnModule instance;
    public VpnModule(ReactApplicationContext context) {
        super(context);
        instance = this;
        context.addActivityEventListener(this);
    }
    @NonNull @Override
    public String getName() { return "VpnModule"; }
    @ReactMethod
    public void prepare(Promise promise) {
        try {
            Activity activity = getCurrentActivity();
            if (activity == null) { promise.reject("NO_ACTIVITY", "No activity"); return; }
            Intent intent = VpnService.prepare(activity);
            if (intent != null) { vpnPermissionPromise = promise; activity.startActivityForResult(intent, VPN_REQUEST_CODE); }
            else { promise.resolve(true); }
        } catch (Exception e) { promise.reject("VPN_PREPARE_ERROR", e.getMessage()); }
    }
    @ReactMethod
    public void startVpn(String relayUrl, String sessionCode, String role, Promise promise) {
        try {
            Context ctx = getReactApplicationContext();
            Intent i = new Intent(ctx, NetShareVpnService.class);
            i.putExtra("RELAY_URL", relayUrl);
            i.putExtra("SESSION_CODE", sessionCode);
            i.putExtra("ROLE", role);
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) ctx.startForegroundService(i);
            else ctx.startService(i);
            promise.resolve(true);
        } catch (Exception e) { promise.reject("VPN_START_ERROR", e.getMessage()); }
    }
    @ReactMethod
    public void stopVpn(Promise promise) {
        try {
            // FIXED #5: use stopService() — not startService() — to stop a foreground
            // service safely from the background on Android 8+.
            Context ctx = getReactApplicationContext();
            Intent i = new Intent(ctx, NetShareVpnService.class);
            ctx.stopService(i);
            promise.resolve(true);
        } catch (Exception e) { promise.reject("VPN_STOP_ERROR", e.getMessage()); }
    }
    // FIXED #6: emitEvent now retrieves context from the module instance safely
    public static void emitEvent(String eventName, String data) {
        if (instance == null) return;
        ReactApplicationContext ctx = instance.getReactApplicationContext();
        if (ctx != null && ctx.hasActiveCatalystInstance())
            ctx.getJSModule(DeviceEventManagerModule.RCTDeviceEventEmitter.class).emit(eventName, data);
    }
    @Override
    public void onActivityResult(Activity activity, int requestCode, int resultCode, Intent data) {
        if (requestCode == VPN_REQUEST_CODE && vpnPermissionPromise != null) {
            vpnPermissionPromise.resolve(resultCode == Activity.RESULT_OK);
            vpnPermissionPromise = null;
        }
    }
    @Override public void onNewIntent(Intent intent) {}
}
"""

# ── NetShareVpnService.java ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# FIXED #7: handleRelayMessage() now uses org.json.JSONObject for safe parsing.
# FIXED #10: FileOutputStream for TUN write is cached as a field, not re-created per packet.
vpn_service = """\
package com.netsharebuild.netshare;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.VpnService;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;
import android.util.Log;
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat;
import org.java_websocket.client.WebSocketClient;
import org.java_websocket.handshake.ServerHandshake;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.Socket;
import java.net.URI;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import javax.net.ssl.SSLSocketFactory;
public class NetShareVpnService extends VpnService {
    private static final String TAG = "NetShareVPN";
    private static final String CHANNEL_ID = "netshare_vpn";
    private static final int NOTIFICATION_ID = 1;
    private ParcelFileDescriptor vpnInterface;
    // FIXED #10: cached TUN output stream — not re-created on every packet
    private FileOutputStream tunOutputStream;
    private WebSocketClient wsClient;
    private ExecutorService executor;
    private volatile boolean isRunning = false;
    private String relayUrl, sessionCode, role;
    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        if (intent != null && "STOP_VPN".equals(intent.getAction())) {
            stopVpnTunnel(); return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        relayUrl    = intent.getStringExtra("RELAY_URL");
        sessionCode = intent.getStringExtra("SESSION_CODE");
        role        = intent.getStringExtra("ROLE");
        startForegroundNotification();
        executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);
        executor.execute(this::startVpnTunnel);
        return START_STICKY;
    }
    private void startVpnTunnel() {
        try {
            vpnInterface = new Builder()
                .setSession("NetShare")
                .addAddress("10.8.0.2", 24)
                .addRoute("0.0.0.0", 0)
                .addDnsServer("8.8.8.8")
                .addDnsServer("8.8.4.4")
                .setMtu(1500)
                .addDisallowedApplication(getPackageName())
                .establish();
            if (vpnInterface == null) { VpnModule.emitEvent("vpnError", "Failed to establish VPN"); return; }
            // FIXED #10: initialise cached output stream once after VPN is established
            tunOutputStream = new FileOutputStream(vpnInterface.getFileDescriptor());
            isRunning = true;
            VpnModule.emitEvent("vpnConnected", sessionCode);
            connectToRelay();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "startVpnTunnel: " + e.getMessage());
            VpnModule.emitEvent("vpnError", e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    private void connectToRelay() throws Exception {
        URI uri = new URI(relayUrl);
        final NetShareVpnService self = this;
        wsClient = new WebSocketClient(uri) {
            @Override public void onOpen(ServerHandshake h) {
                if ("host".equals(role)) send("{\\\"type\\\":\\\"HOST_REGISTER\\\",\\\"netType\\\":\\\"WiFi\\\"}");
                else send("{\\\"type\\\":\\\"CLIENT_JOIN\\\",\\\"code\\\":\\\"" + sessionCode + "\\\"}");
            }
            @Override public void onMessage(String msg) { handleRelayMessage(msg); }
            @Override public void onMessage(ByteBuffer bytes) {
                // FIXED #10: write to cached stream instead of constructing a new one each call
                if (tunOutputStream != null && isRunning) {
                    try { tunOutputStream.write(bytes.array(), bytes.position(), bytes.remaining()); }
                    catch (Exception e) { Log.e(TAG, "TUN write: " + e.getMessage()); }
                }
            }
            @Override public void onClose(int code, String reason, boolean remote) {
                VpnModule.emitEvent("vpnDisconnected", reason != null ? reason : "closed");
                isRunning = false;
            }
            @Override public void onError(Exception ex) {
                VpnModule.emitEvent("vpnError", ex != null ? ex.getMessage() : "unknown error");
            }
        };
        wsClient.setSocketFactory(new SSLSocketFactory() {
            private final SSLSocketFactory d = (SSLSocketFactory) SSLSocketFactory.getDefault();
            @Override public Socket createSocket() throws IOException {
                Socket s = new Socket(); self.protect(s); return s; }
            @Override public Socket createSocket(String h, int p) throws IOException {
                Socket s = d.createSocket(h, p); self.protect(s); return s; }
            @Override public Socket createSocket(String h, int p, InetAddress la, int lp) throws IOException {
                Socket s = d.createSocket(h, p, la, lp); self.protect(s); return s; }
            @Override public Socket createSocket(InetAddress h, int p) throws IOException {
                Socket s = d.createSocket(h, p); self.protect(s); return s; }
            @Override public Socket createSocket(InetAddress a, int p, InetAddress la, int lp) throws IOException {
                Socket s = d.createSocket(a, p, la, lp); self.protect(s); return s; }
            @Override public Socket createSocket(Socket s, String h, int p, boolean ac) throws IOException {
                Socket ns = d.createSocket(s, h, p, ac); self.protect(ns); return ns; }
            @Override public String[] getDefaultCipherSuites() { return d.getDefaultCipherSuites(); }
            @Override public String[] getSupportedCipherSuites() { return d.getSupportedCipherSuites(); }
        });
        wsClient.connectBlocking();
        if ("client".equals(role)) startPacketReadLoop();
    }
    private void startPacketReadLoop() {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            byte[] packet = new byte[32767];
            try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(vpnInterface.getFileDescriptor())) {
                while (isRunning) {
                    int len = in.read(packet);
                    if (len > 0 && wsClient != null && wsClient.isOpen())
                        wsClient.send(ByteBuffer.wrap(packet, 0, len));
                }
            } catch (Exception e) { if (isRunning) Log.e(TAG, "Read: " + e.getMessage()); }
        });
    }
    // FIXED #7: replaced brittle String.split() JSON parsing with org.json.JSONObject
    private void handleRelayMessage(String msg) {
        try {
            JSONObject json = new JSONObject(msg);
            String type = json.optString("type", "");
            switch (type) {
                case "SESSION_CREATED":
                    VpnModule.emitEvent("sessionCreated", json.optString("code", ""));
                    break;
                case "JOIN_SUCCESS":
                    VpnModule.emitEvent("joinSuccess", sessionCode);
                    break;
                case "JOIN_ERROR":
                    VpnModule.emitEvent("joinError", json.optString("reason", "unknown"));
                    break;
                case "CLIENT_CONNECTED":
                    VpnModule.emitEvent("clientConnected", json.optString("clientId", ""));
                    break;
                case "CLIENT_DISCONNECTED":
                    VpnModule.emitEvent("clientDisconnected", "");
                    break;
                case "HOST_LEFT":
                    VpnModule.emitEvent("hostLeft", "Host ended the session");
                    break;
                case "PING":
                    if (wsClient != null && wsClient.isOpen())
                        wsClient.send("{\\\"type\\\":\\\"PONG\\\"}");
                    break;
                default:
                    Log.d(TAG, "Unhandled relay message type: " + type);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) { Log.e(TAG, "handleRelayMessage: " + e.getMessage()); }
    }
    private void stopVpnTunnel() {
        isRunning = false;
        try {
            if (wsClient != null) {
                wsClient.send("host".equals(role) ? "{\\\"type\\\":\\\"HOST_LEAVE\\\"}" : "{\\\"type\\\":\\\"CLIENT_LEAVE\\\"}");
                wsClient.close();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        // FIXED #10: close cached output stream
        try { if (tunOutputStream != null) { tunOutputStream.close(); tunOutputStream = null; } } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try { if (vpnInterface != null) { vpnInterface.close(); vpnInterface = null; } } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (executor != null) executor.shutdownNow();
        VpnModule.emitEvent("vpnDisconnected", "User stopped sharing");
        stopForeground(true);
        stopSelf();
    }
    private void startForegroundNotification() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
            getSystemService(NotificationManager.class).createNotificationChannel(
                new NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID, "NetShare VPN", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW));
        PendingIntent stop = PendingIntent.getService(this, 0,
            new Intent(this, NetShareVpnService.class).setAction("STOP_VPN"),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        startForeground(NOTIFICATION_ID, new NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
            .setContentTitle("NetShare Active")
            .setContentText("Sharing internet via relay...")
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_share)
            .addAction(android.R.drawable.ic_delete, "Stop", stop)
            .setOngoing(true).build());
    }
    @Override public void onDestroy() { stopVpnTunnel(); super.onDestroy(); }
}
"""

with open(dest + "/VpnPackage.java", "w") as f: f.write(vpn_package)
with open(dest + "/VpnModule.java",  "w") as f: f.write(vpn_module)
with open(dest + "/NetShareVpnService.java", "w") as f: f.write(vpn_service)
print("=== Java files written ===")
for name in ["VpnPackage.java","VpnModule.java","NetShareVpnService.java"]:
    with open(dest+"/"+name) as f: print(f.readline().strip(), "->", name)
PYEOF

      # ── Patch MainApplication.kt ──────────────────────────────
      # FIXED #3: sed pattern now detects the actual package line dynamically
      # instead of hardcoding 'com.netsharebuild', which may not match RN output.
      - name: Patch MainApplication.kt
        run: |
          FILE=$(find "$BUILD_DIR/android" -name "MainApplication.kt" | head -1)
          echo "Patching: $FILE"
          # Detect the actual package line from the generated file
          ACTUAL_PKG=$(grep '^package ' "$FILE" | head -1 | sed 's/^package //' | tr -d '[:space:]')
          echo "Detected package: $ACTUAL_PKG"
          if ! grep -q "VpnPackage" "$FILE"; then
            # Insert import after whatever the actual package declaration line is
            sed -i "/^package ${ACTUAL_PKG//./\\.}$/a import com.netsharebuild.netshare.VpnPackage" "$FILE"
            sed -i 's/PackageList(this)\.packages/PackageList(this).packages.also { it.add(VpnPackage()) }/' "$FILE"
          fi
          head -20 "$FILE"

      # ── Patch build.gradle ────────────────────────────────────
      # FIXED #2: namespace is now set to 'com.netsharebuild.netshare' to match
      # Java package declarations in all native files.
      - name: Patch app build.gradle
        run: |
          python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import re, os

gradle_path = os.environ["BUILD_DIR"] + "/android/app/build.gradle"
with open(gradle_path) as f:
    c = f.read()

# FIXED #2: namespace must match the Java package 'com.netsharebuild.netshare'
if 'namespace' not in c:
    c = c.replace('android {', 'android {\n    namespace "com.netsharebuild.netshare"', 1)

# Fix SDK versions to 34
c = re.sub(r'compileSdkVersion\s+\d+', 'compileSdkVersion 34', c)
c = re.sub(r'compileSdk\s*=\s*\d+',    'compileSdk = 34', c)
c = re.sub(r'compileSdk\s+\d+',         'compileSdk 34', c)
c = re.sub(r'targetSdkVersion\s+\d+',   'targetSdkVersion 34', c)
c = re.sub(r'targetSdk\s*=\s*\d+',      'targetSdk = 34', c)
c = re.sub(r'targetSdk\s+\d+',          'targetSdk 34', c)

# Add java-websocket
if 'java-websocket' not in c:
    c = c.replace('dependencies {',
        'dependencies {\n    implementation "org.java-websocket:Java-WebSocket:1.5.4"', 1)

# Embed JS bundle in debug APK (fixes "Could not connect to dev server")
if 'bundleInDebug' not in c:
    if 'project.ext.react = [' in c:
        c = c.replace('project.ext.react = [',
            'project.ext.react = [\n        bundleInDebug: true,', 1)
    else:
        c = 'project.ext.react = [\n    bundleInDebug: true\n]\n\n' + c

with open(gradle_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(c)

print("build.gradle patched OK")
for line in c.splitlines():
    if any(k in line for k in ['compileSdk','targetSdk','java-websocket','bundle','namespace']):
        print(" >>", line.strip())
PYEOF

      # ── Fix gradle.properties ─────────────────────────────────
      - name: Fix gradle.properties
        run: |
          python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import os

props_path = os.environ["BUILD_DIR"] + "/android/gradle.properties"
with open(props_path) as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

result, seen = [], set()
for line in lines:
    key = line.split('=')[0].strip()
    if key == 'org.gradle.jvmargs':
        result.append('org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4g -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=512m\n')
    elif key == 'android.useAndroidX':
        result.append('android.useAndroidX=true\n')
    elif key == 'android.enableJetifier':
        result.append('android.enableJetifier=true\n')
    else:
        result.append(line)
    seen.add(key)

if 'org.gradle.jvmargs'     not in seen: result.append('org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4g -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=512m\n')
if 'android.useAndroidX'    not in seen: result.append('android.useAndroidX=true\n')
if 'android.enableJetifier' not in seen: result.append('android.enableJetifier=true\n')

with open(props_path, 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(result)
print("gradle.properties OK")
PYEOF

      # ── Install Node dependencies ─────────────────────────────
      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm install
        working-directory: /home/runner/NetShareBuild

      # ── Copy vector icon fonts (required by react-native-vector-icons) ──
      - name: Copy vector icon fonts
        run: |
          FONTS_SRC="$BUILD_DIR/node_modules/react-native-vector-icons/Fonts"
          FONTS_DEST="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/assets/fonts"
          mkdir -p "$FONTS_DEST"
          if [ -d "$FONTS_SRC" ]; then
            cp "$FONTS_SRC"/*.ttf "$FONTS_DEST/"
            echo "Fonts copied: $(ls $FONTS_DEST | wc -l) files"
          else
            echo "No fonts dir found, skipping"
          fi

      # ── Bundle JS into Android assets ─────────────────────────
      # FIXED #4: using absolute $BUILD_DIR paths instead of relative paths
      # to avoid fragile working-directory-dependent mkdir behaviour.
      - name: Bundle JS into Android assets
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/assets"
          npx react-native bundle \
            --platform android \
            --dev false \
            --entry-file index.js \
            --bundle-output "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle" \
            --assets-dest "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/res" \
            --reset-cache
        working-directory: /home/runner/NetShareBuild
        env:
          CI: false
          NODE_ENV: production

      # ── Build Debug APK ───────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Build Debug APK
        run: |
          cd android
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace
        working-directory: /home/runner/NetShareBuild
        env:
          ANDROID_HOME: ${{ env.ANDROID_HOME }}
          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env.JAVA_HOME }}

      # ── Verify APK ────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Verify APK
        run: |
          APK="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
          if [ ! -f "$APK" ]; then
            echo "APK not found!"
            find "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/build" -name "*.apk" 2>/dev/null || echo "No APK anywhere"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "SUCCESS: $(du -h $APK)"

      # ── Upload APK artifact ───────────────────────────────────
      - name: Upload APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: NetShare-debug-apk
          path: /home/runner/NetShareBuild/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          retention-days: 30

      # ── Create GitHub Release ─────────────────────────────────
      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ github.run_number }}
          name: NetShare v${{ github.run_number }}
          body: |
            ## NetShare APK - Build #${{ github.run_number }}
            1. Download **app-debug.apk** below
            2. Transfer to your Android phone
            3. Tap Install (enable "Unknown sources" if asked)
            4. Works standalone — no development server needed
          files: /home/runner/NetShareBuild/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
